title: Move marketing routes, components, and lib modules to Chattic.us-web

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Move to Chattic.us-web: routes /, /beta, /contact/*, /features/*, /waitlist/*.
Components: Hero, Header, Footer, Wordmark, ControlSystem,
DelegatedResponsibility, Evidence, Faq, FinalCta, OrganizationStory,
RealityLedger, BetaAccessDisclosure, BetaPageAnalytics, BetaSetupPricing,
BetaWaitlistSurveyForm, ContactForm, WaitlistConfirmPanel, WaitlistInvitePanel,
workspace/WorkspaceDemo.tsx, workspace/demoScenarios.ts. Lib modules:
analytics.ts, contact-api.ts, conversion-tracking.ts, waitlist-api.ts,
waitlist-survey-fixture.ts, wordmark-presence.ts.

WorkspaceDemo consumes the shared workspace/* components from task 6's export
rather than a local copy — this is the one place marketing and product share
runtime UI, not just tokens.

Depends on task 6 (the shared package must exist to import against) and task 7
(the repo must exist to move files into).
